description: 1-cell Li-ion fuel gauge (ModelGauge: state of charge from the cell voltage, no sense resistor), I2C 0x36, 3 uA hibernate (TDFN-8 2x2 mm)

datasheet.revision: 19-6171 Rev 7, 11/16: Pin/Bump Descriptions, Figure 14 application circuit, Table 3, Electrical Characteristics, Package Information (T822+3, outline 21-0168)

pins.name: CELL
pins.description: MAX17048: not connected inside; connect to the positive battery terminal

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: supply and voltage sense: the positive battery terminal, 0.1 uF to GND

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (internal pull-down senses a disconnected bus)

absMax.what: VDD, CELL and other pins to GND

notes: 1S pack-side: VDD and CELL from the battery directly, QSTRT to GND; ALRT to a GPIO (it needs a pull-up) or open.
The I2C address is fixed: 0x6C write / 0x6D read, i.e. 7-bit 0x36.

pins.source: MAX17048/MAX17049 datasheet 19-6171 Rev 7, Pin/Bump Descriptions (TDFN 1 CTG, 2 CELL, 3 VDD, 4 GND, 5 ALRT, 6 QSTRT, 7 SCL, 8 SDA, EP); package T822+3, outline 21-0168 (2 x 2 mm, 0.5 mm pitch; exposed pad 0.8 x 1.2 mm as KiCad's footprint for 21-0168 gives it)
